result.instructions: Query a synthetic shop database (users, products, orders, logs).

tools.description: Gives an overview of the shop database: every table together with how many rows it currently holds. A good first step before writing a query.
tools.name: list_tables

tools.description: Explains how a table is structured, listing each column with its type and whether it can be empty. Useful when you are not sure about column names.
tools.name: describe_table

tools.description: Runs a SELECT query against the shop database and returns the matching rows. Only reading is allowed, and very large results are cut off after 200 rows.
tools.name: read_query

tools.description: Adds a new record to either the orders table or the logs table. Pass the values as a mapping from column name to value; the new row id is returned.
tools.name: insert_row

arguments.sql: SELECT id, name, category, price, stock FROM products
